dataset: CityMETER Place of Worship — bounded fuzzy-search demo

coverage.areas: All area names returned by current public base/info/lv0 plus77 province base/info/lv1 endpoints; a CityMETER corpus snapshot, not a statutory boundary authority.
coverage.places: 1,491 mapped public places in126 selected subdistricts across77 provinces;3.84% of national mapped records. These are illustrative coverage, not statistically representative.
sampleMethod: Highest public pointCount subdistrict in each of77 provinces.
Every subdistrict with positive Sikh count in the refreshed province summaries.
Selected metropolitan subdistricts: Bangkok Phra Nakhon,Bang Rak,Samphanthawong,Thon Buri,Bangkok Yai districts;Mueang Chiang Mai district;Hat Yai,Koh Hong,andBo Yang subdistricts inSongkhla.
coverage.samplingBias: Purposive/high-count and metropolitan selection; sample religion proportions and results must not be presented as national distribution.
coverage.excluded: No point names or invented coordinates for13,059 nationwide admin-only records; no private contacts, officials, clergy, land records, congregation counts, or personal information retained.
coverage.negativeResultMeaning: Not found means absent from this indexed snapshot or below matching threshold; it does not mean the worship place does not exist.

coordinates.places: Exact source lat/lon properties returned in public MVT; tile geometry was not used for the demo coordinates.
coordinates.areas: Center of source EPSG:3857 extent converted toWGS84 for map display; not an entrance, address, centroid of polygon, or containment evidence.
coordinates.reason: One world tile for each explicit subdistrict scope; avoids sweeping tiles.
coordinates.geometryCaveat: MVT geometry atzoom0 is coarsely quantized and intentionally ignored in favor of source lat/lon properties.

identity.placeId: Source public place id preserved as placeId; demo id is poi:<sourcePlaceId>.
identity.placeParents: SUBDISTRICT membership proven by selected public overlay query;DISTRICT via exact four-digit subdistrict code prefix matching a current district record;PROVINCE from the containing current province response.
identity.areaParents: Province from containing public response;SUBDISTRICT->DISTRICT by exact current code prefix. Municipality andLocale do not receive invented district/subdistrict parents.
identity.canonicalNames: Original source Thai andEnglish strings are preserved. MissingEnglish names stay null.
identity.aliases: Only source province abbrEn values included initially; no generated transliterations or unverified place aliases.

baseline.kind: Actual public existing-search responses, not a reimplementation of its backend.
baseline.scope: Existing global area search; observed client has no dataset-aware worship name search. Old area search and new combined search have different retrieval scope; evaluation must report this separately from typo correction.
baseline.latencyCaveat: Captured search response content is static for this demo; do not compare local runtime timing to production network latency.

limits: PublicAPI does not expose a name bulk list for national admin-only records through the observed client contract.
Source current version and operational status were not independently verified against upstream registries.
Source religion/status fields describe dataset records; they do not establish actual personal belief, citizen behavior, eligibility, risk, or live opening hours.
NoLocale Insight used to infer population, demand, religion, risk, or behavior.
